notes.title: Windose Update 1.02
notes.content:
The game has been updated

[h3]Typing of the Net[/h3]
[list]
[*] Revised the options for the number of lives. As a result, if you continue playing from an older version, the selected number of lives may differ from before, so please take note.
[*] For those who are stuck and unable to progress, we’ve made it clearer that the number of lives can be adjusted.
[*] Fixed a bug where earning a negative score could occur when a very large number of mistypes were made.
[*] Fixed an issue in Japanese mode where unnatural behavior could occur when the text contained the character "ん".
[*] In Japanese mode, you can now use "X～" or "L～" to input the small "っ".
[*] In Japanese mode, you can now use "CY～" to input the "ちゃ" row of characters.
[/list]

[h3]Endless Nightmare[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed the default window size to x4 upon the first launch.
[*] Added operation guides to some screen edges.
[*] When retrying, players will now resume from Lv3.
[*] Bosses now drop level-up items when hit with a chainsaw attack.
[*] Reduced the HP of Stage 4 and Stage 5 bosses.
[*] Adjusted the timing for displaying the operation guide during the struggle phase of the Stage 5 boss fight.
[*] Modified some tutorial text.
[*] To adjust input difficulty, the following changes have been applied specifically for keyboard input:
[*] When performing high-speed movement or jumping, players can move further horizontally even without pressing the left or right inputs.
[*] Wall jumps now always result in a long jump regardless of left or right input. (To move further after jumping, directional input is still required.)
[*] Increased the jump distance for wall jumps.
[/list]

notes.title: Windose Update 1.01
notes.content:
The game has been updated

[h3]Typing of The Net[/h3]
・Fixed an issue where the game shows gibberish and cannot be proceeded when the Steam client language was set to Traditional Chinese or Korean. If this issue is affecting you currently, restarting the game with the updated version will result in a fix.
・A button has been added to close the game. To close the game, click on the "x" at the top left of the home screen.
・When playing in Japanese, "L~" can now be used to input komoji.
・When playing in Japanese, "WH~" can now be used to input "ウァ".
・Life can now be increased. From the settings screen a choice can be made between "3/5/7/10/infinite" life points. Score and rank can still be gained regardless of life points.

[h3]ENDLESS NIGHTMARE[/h3]
・Some keyboard input issues have been fixed, such as not being able to wall jump and not being able to cancel post-jump stun by sliding.
・Fixed an issue where an unintended tutorial was placed in Stage 0.
・Fixed an issue with missing staff credits.
・Other minor bug fixes.
